searchText: Hello, I'm looking forward to connecting with clients who are building projects now. Hi, I'm Ivan, am new with core Ethereum R&D (came here after chatting with PSE guys and reading Vitalik's The Verge to check out the current discussions), trying to learn and see if I can be of any help to the community, with the ZK stuff especially. Am looking for a job or a grant (or any support) at the moment but not here, obviously. This Discord is for Ethereum R&D discussion. It isn't for application layer job hunting
